run_speedup_benchmark: run the speedup function to compare new and old benchmark timing lists and return percentage change
run_scale_list: run the scale function to multiply every element in a list by a given scalar value
run_cmp_ttest: run the cmp function to perform an independent t-test between two sample lists using scipy
test_speedup_regression: test the speedup function with new and old benchmark data to detect statistically significant slowdowns
summarize_speedup_analysis: summarize the speedup function which uses t-tests and iterative scaling to measure benchmark performance differences
